uzo.purpose: Moves through the pages of a long list and shows which page is current; with first-last it jumps to the first and the last page.

instead.kialo: A list that grows by one more part on demand is a button, because the person stays on one page and the list gets longer; pages are places a person can return to.
Views of one thing on one page are tabs, because the person switches what is shown of the same thing; pages are parts of one list in order.

boundary.kialo: A list that loads as the person scrolls has no pages and no end a keyboard can reach, because the footer never comes; a person decides whether the list needs pages or a button for more.
How many rows a page holds is a choice of its own, an elektilo beside the pagination, because the pagination moves between pages and does not resize them; a person decides where that choice stands.

containers.name: list-foot
containers.kialo: A pagination stands under the list it pages, because the person reaches it after the rows; the container owns the space between.

with.kialo: A table with more rows than one page shows has a pagination under it, because the table shows one part at a time (the tabelo's boundary pagination).
The arrows back and forth are the ikono chevron-left and chevron-right, because an arrow is a sign of the system and mirrors in right-to-left writing.

case.de: Die Liste soll auf Wunsch um einen weiteren Teil länger werden.
case.en: The list is to grow by one more part on demand.

case.de: Es sind Ansichten eines Dings, keine Teile einer Liste.
case.en: These are views of one thing, not parts of a list.

do.de: Wähle mode link, wenn jede Seite eine eigene Adresse hat; sonst mode button.
do.en: Choose mode link when every page has an address of its own; otherwise mode button.

do.de: Setze total-unknown, solange das Ende der Liste nicht bekannt ist.
do.en: Set total-unknown as long as the end of the list is not known.

do.de: Nimm size small unter einer dichten Tabelle.
do.en: Use size small below a dense table.

dont.de: Eine Liste beim Rollen endlos nachladen statt Seiten zu bieten, denn die Tastatur erreicht ihr Ende nie.
dont.en: Load a list endlessly while scrolling instead of offering pages, because the keyboard never reaches its end.

dont.de: Die Wahl, wie viele Zeilen eine Seite hat, in den Seitenumschalter packen; sie ist eine eigene Auswahl daneben.
dont.en: Put the choice of how many rows a page holds into the pagination; it is a choice of its own beside it.

none.de: Der Seitenumschalter nimmt keine eigene Taste; jede Seite ist eine Schaltfläche oder ein Verweis, den man mit Tab erreicht und mit Enter wählt.
none.en: The pagination takes no key of its own; every page is a button or a link reached with Tab and chosen with Enter.
